title: feat(digital-factory-ui-visual-bugfix/T7): feature-origin task tab navigation and tab flicker hardening
body:
## T7 — Feature-origin task tab navigation and tab flicker hardening

### Changes
- Added `parentFeatureTabSessionId` to `TaskTabEntry` type to store feature return context on task tabs opened from a feature tab.
- Updated `closeTaskTab` in WorkspaceContext to check for `parentFeatureTabSessionId` and reactivate the parent feature tab instead of going to `/board`.
- Replaced inline `FeatureTaskDrilldown` in `FeatureTabView` with workspace `openTaskTab` activation, which opens a proper task tab.
- Added `parentFeatureTabSessionId` to the task tab entry when `openTaskTab` is called from a feature tab, preserving the feature tab session ID as return context.
- When Back is pressed on a feature-origin task tab, `closeTaskTab` detects the parent feature tab session and reactivates that feature tab, keeping it open.
- Direct board-origin task tabs (without `parentFeatureTabSessionId`) keep the existing behavior: close task tab and return to `/board`.
- The parent feature tab stays open when the feature-origin task tab is closed.
- Flicker hardening is handled by the existing TanStack Query cache layer (`loading: isFetching && !data` pattern) from T3 migration.
- Updated `FeatureTasksPanel` to use `onOpenTaskTab` instead of `onDrilldown`.
- Updated re-exports and test imports to reference `FeatureTaskDrilldown` from its direct file path.

### Tests
Added `t7-feature-origin-task-nav.test.ts` covering:
- `tabState` helpers preserve `parentFeatureTabSessionId`
- `closeTaskTab` removes the correct task tab entry
- Task tabs with `parentFeatureTabSessionId` are properly handled
- `FeatureTasksPanel` calls `onOpenTaskTab` with task details
- `FeatureTabView` renders without drilldown content

All 1315 tests pass across 64 test files.

### Subtasks completed
- [x] Replace the feature task inline drilldown primary action with workspace `openTaskTab` / task-tab activation
- [x] Store feature return context on task tabs opened from a feature tab
- [x] Update task-tab Back behavior so feature-origin task tabs close/remove only the task tab and reactivate the parent feature tab
- [x] Preserve direct board-origin task-tab Back behavior: close the task tab and return to `/board`
- [x] Keep the parent feature tab open when returning from a feature-origin task tab
- [x] Prevent task/feature tab switches from clearing visible content when cached or previous data exists
- [x] Add component tests for feature-to-task tab opening, Back cleanup, parent feature reactivation, and no blank/flicker tab switching
